fields.label: Agent
fields.description: One tenant-wide model per agent: the container runs ONE delegate per agent slug.

fields.label: State
fields.description: legacy = pushed unpinned (today's behaviour); auto = best eligible picked by Jarvis; chosen = picked by a user; changed = moved to a fallback after the choice stopped being eligible; needs_model = nothing eligible, runs blocked.

fields.label: Provider
fields.description: Provider id exactly as the pool push sends it ("" for a pooled subscription row).

fields.label: Fallbacks
fields.description: Up to 3 eligible {provider, model} refs, stored at validation time so the push is a pure read.

fields.label: Pushed Provider
fields.description: The choice the last successful Apply sent; differs from provider/model while an Apply is pending.

fields.label: Fleet Unresolved
fields.description: The fleet could not resolve the pushed model in the current render; cleared on the next successful run start.

fields.label: Admin Rejected
fields.description: {fp, refs}: models admin refused for this workspace on the last Apply; excluded until the pool/catalog fingerprint changes.
